name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal-forced~p2
task: Taking the key means you must open the door too.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) adds a requirement the task does not state. “Taking the key” refers to acquiring it, but the environment says the agent starts holding the key, so this rule makes opening the door mandatory. The task only says that taking the key means the door must also be opened; it does not command taking the key or opening the door. Remove this clause.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) captures the task’s requirement that holding the key means the door must also be opened at some point. The task states no unconditional goal.

texts: If the key is held, the door must also be opened at some point.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, door_open) -> u2
(u1, door_open) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, door_open, u2) -> 1
